resumen:
I regenerated both outputs in order, 'python preparar_geometria.py' then 'python urbanismo.py'. Both exit 0, and urbanismo's QA has 0 failures across all 19 checks (the 11 old ones plus 8 new ones). The isolated test 'python terreno_montana.py' on the snapshot also runs (10.5 s, same figures). The six objectives, measured:

(1) SENTIDO. Both files share the same rule: the spec's 'sentido' field wins, then the old boolean 'sube', then the rule by id. Geography comes out 'coherente' in all 7 sectors. bajada_ladera now goes BAJA (natural terrain -4/-26 m at 60/100 m). casino_ladera +1 SUBE (+14/+30). casino_mar -1 BAJA (-14/-23).

(2) EMPTY TERRACES: 0, checked automatically in the QA. pueblo_subida_mar terrace 1 now has a 292 m street, 22 houses, 2 ramps and 2 stairways. Two fixes made that possible: travesias now search for their end between u_hi-1.5 and u_hi, and the ramp is tried in several lateral positions. Walls bordering a terrace with no live street are no longer exported.

(3) DENSITY: 216 houses (target 190), up from 143. By sector: subida_ladera 69, subida_mar 46, alto_ladera 42, alto_mar 17, bajada 17, casino_ladera 11, casino_mar 14. Gaps over 12 m between consecutive lots in a row add up to 286 m (target < 300; 1003 m at the last review), not counting travesias, ramps, stairs and plazas. Of that, 156 m is in the interior corner of C6 in pueblo_subida_ladera; the rest is the casino hairpins (37+39 m), pueblo_alto t1/t2 (12+25 m) and bajada t1 (14 m).
What made the difference:
- Terrain and urbanismo now use one height function. CotaSector/mezcla_cota lives in terreno_montana.py and is used both to carve and to place streets and houses. Measured terrain-minus-rule on the flat band: 0.00-0.02 m.
- Width checks on the facade and the terraces were fixed. Before, the depth limit applied even in front of ramps that were planned but then discarded. The plaza was never placed because it required a depth of 11 m when the band measures 10.8.
- Ramps are 5.0 m wide (4.0 m of roadway). In front of a ramp, lots can be 4 m deep. Narrower fallback lots (5.5-6.5 m) are tried.
- There are 7 ramps and 3 plazas with fountains. The two casino sectors have no plaza: the 13.5 % slope leaves no flat 24 m stretch.

(4) TRENCH BEHIND THE LAST TERRACE: 0 of 868 samples exceed 1.5 m. The maximum is 1.40 m in casino_mar; per sector 0.79 / 0.47 / 0.41 / 0.29 / 0.20 / 0.82 / 1.40. The metric is the depth of water that would be trapped in the normal profile from o_fin-3 to o_fin+40. The profile is cut where it meets another road's corridor, the sea, or another set of flat terraces. The old criterion also gives 0. Behind the terraces the terrain is filled up to the trapped-water level (at most the terrace level minus 0.6). The edges of the fill slope down at 55 % and the passes repeat until nothing changes; 1347 cells are raised by more than 1.5 m. That fill alone did not remove the dark 20-30 m steps behind C6. They came from the car-mountain cut slope, which switched abruptly from 1.15 to 2.0 between neighbouring cells; it now varies smoothly.

(5) FULL FOOTPRINTS in the QA and in placement. Worst deviations:
- travesias 0.60 m (limit 0.6)
- terrain above a ramp's roadway 0.43 m (limit 0.6); along the parapet lines 0.66 m (limit 0.9)
- plazoletas 0.58 m, plazas 0.49 m (limit 0.6)
- street edges -0.79..+0.53 m (the reviewer had flagged up to 1.57 m in the air)
- houses -0.50..+0.90 m on a 1 m grid, with a terrain range of at most 1.00 m (16 houses were over 1.0 m before)

(6) GUARANTEES:
- Terrain: 0 cells invade the track or the viaduct, 0 corridor cells at the two-road minimum, 0 terraces cut by the pit box, mirador ledge applied.
- Casino rock: contour at most 119.3 m, 29/64 points in the sea, 0 cells inside the ellipse above the cap, 0 town elements inside the contour.
- Seams: urbanismo rebuilds T1's seam map (cells over 0.6 m) and keeps buildings clear of it. Using the reviewer's own probe on a recomputed T1, the count is 0 within 2.5 m of a lot and 0 within 4.75 m of a street or travesia axis (it was 15 before).
- Every street piece of the service road keeps an access link at each end; two were moved 4 m inward and the street trimmed.

OTHER CHANGES:
- The terreno_costuras.png panels now show only their own sector and their titles no longer overlap.
- The unused panels in terreno_secciones.png are hidden.
- Both docstrings describe the RONDA 15c changes.
- curvas_en_metros is a safety net in case the curves arrive in SVG units. The coordinator has already fixed the call in preparar, so it currently does nothing.
pendiente:
1) The reviewer's probe uses the nominal terrace height Z(s)+h as reference and does not cut the profile. With that probe, 24 samples are still flagged, all with a minimum 1.5-2.2 m below nominal:
- pueblo_subida_ladera s 916-1008 (17 samples): the minimum is at o=62, which is on the blended last terrace itself, and only the mountain rises behind it.
- pueblo_alto_ladera s 1461-1525 (5) and bajada s 2732 (1): sector ends next to the other road.
- casino_mar s 3387 (1).
None of them traps more than 1.40 m of water. Clearing them would mean changing T1's blend between opposing branches (for example, putting a retaining wall in the corner instead of the 68 % slope).
2) The C6 corner of pueblo_subida_ladera stays a slope with no streets or houses. On the inside of the bend (R 25-50 m, track climbing 15 %) a street would reach about 23-24 % (the limit is 18 %). That corner is 156 of the 286 m of gaps; any change there brings the total close to 300 again.
3) T1's own seam map is unchanged: 110 cells over 0.6 m, maximum 2.01 m, in the C6 corner and the casino hairpins. Buildings are now kept away from them, but they still exist.
4) Integrator-facing changes the coordinator needs to know:
- ramps now have 'ancho' 5.0 and 'ancho_calzada' 4.0
- a plaza can sit on any terrace (k other than 0)
- new keys in urbanismo.json qa: huecos, huecos_suma_m, terrazas_vacias, peor_huella
5) Still out of my scope: the McLaren rock mass (17 % of the line at 120 m behind the car is at 90 m or higher, which is incompatible with the spec) and the empty casino plaza.
6) I did not run the full pipeline and did not touch porto_corsa.blend, integrar_escena.py or construir_pista.py. preparar_geometria.py was edited by the coordinator at 16:12 (curves in metres), not by me.
7) Memory note: other agents had 8 Blender processes running and several of my runs failed for lack of paging-file space. Running them again worked, and the results are identical.
